hypotheses.justification: If n = 0, Refines is vacuous. Otherwise split on v < n, using the existing proof in the valid case. When v ≥ n, hp.posSize and getElem!_neg give p.pos[v]! = 0. Set w := p.lab[0]!. Then hp.labLt gives w < n and hp.posLab gives p.pos[w]! = 0. By individualize_cst_eq, individualizing v and w produces identical cst arrays, since these depend on the vertex only through its position. Thus the existing valid-vertex argument for w proves the result for v.
